lines.en: I beat my wings over the canopy.
My shell knocks against branches.
I know this jungle.
I circled above the treetops.
The wind spreads my wings.
I land on a thick branch to rest.

lines.zh: 我这层甲壳，硬得能顶住石头。
lines.en: This shell can take a boulder head-on.
I see movement on the ground.

lines.zh: 我离地半尺，又落回树干。
lines.en: I lift half a block, then settle back on the trunk.
I bend the branch under me.
I fly just over the canopy.

lines.zh: 我降低高度，贴着灌木飞。
lines.en: I drop lower and skim the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我落在你旁边的树桩上。
lines.en: I land on the stump beside you.
My shadow covers the grass.
I perch on a horizontal branch.
There's a sheen on my shell.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收拢，贴在甲下。
lines.en: I fold my wings away beneath my shell.
The jungle is lively.
I hear many sounds.
I'm waiting for a bug.
My horn rests against the bark.
I tilt my antennae.

lines.zh: 湿气顺着甲缝钻进来，很凉。
lines.en: Damp creeps into my shell seams, cool.

lines.zh: 我停在横枝上，不动就好。
lines.en: I perch on the branch; staying still is enough.

lines.zh: 我停在横枝上，等一只虫。
lines.en: I perch on the branch, waiting for an insect.
Wind passes between my wings.
I press my shell to the branch.
These horns can lift a tree trunk.
You're standing under the tree.

lines.zh: 你仰头的高度，只到我甲沿。
lines.en: The height you crane up to reaches only my shell rim.
I look down at you from the branch.
You're not holding a net.
That's good.
Bring a net near, and I fly upward.
My wings are wide when spread.
Get behind that tree.
I don't want to hit you.
One beat of my shell, and the tree shadows shake.

lines.zh: 我落到了低一些的枝上。
lines.en: I drop to a lower branch.
You can see me better now.
Your eyes follow my horn.
I don't plan to attack you.
I still need to find food.
Best not to linger here.
You hit my shell.
A mark stayed on the shell.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖了一下，甲壳还完整。
lines.en: My wings quiver once; my shell is still intact.
It's only on the shell.
I rose a little.
My wings trembled.
Your swing has some weight.

lines.zh: 我落回枝上，甲壳嗡了一声。
lines.en: I land back on the branch; my shell hums.
That one stuck in a shell seam.
I can still fly.
Do you have a bug in your hand?
I eat bugs.
That's too small.

lines.zh: 独角这么长，你举高一点。
lines.en: My horn is this long. Hold it higher.
I'll come down and look.

lines.zh: 你放在地上，我落下去拿。
lines.en: Set it on the ground and I will go down for it.
My horn blocks my view a little.
Don't jerk your hand back.
I'm landing.
Stay just like that.

lines.zh: 甲虫的壳味，我隔着树皮都闻到。
lines.en: The smell of beetle shell reaches me through the bark.
Its shell is moving.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的甲壳上，手先弹开。
lines.en: You hit my shell and your hand bounces off first.
Your charge didn't move me.
Your hand bounced off.
Don't knock the shell on my back.
I turned around once.

lines.zh: 我们一起撞在树上，叶子落下来。
lines.en: We crash into the tree together and leaves fall.
That branch bent.
You backed behind the trunk.
I see every move you make.
The tree can't block my angle.
There are others in the jungle.

lines.zh: 我这一季都在找虫子吃。
lines.en: All season I have been hunting insects.
I spend most of my time eating.
Stay off my branch.

lines.zh: 我的角不太适合这种事。
lines.en: My horn isn't suited to that.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳，是数码合金做的。
lines.en: My shell is digital alloy.
The wind is about to change.
Take care of yourself.
This jungle is large.
There will be others.
I come down to the ground.

lines.zh: 我用前脚拨了拨，它滚进沟里。
lines.en: I nudge it with a foreleg and it rolls into the ditch.

lines.zh: 这壳太硬，我的牙咬不进去。
lines.en: This shell is too hard for my teeth.
Not a beetle.
This dropped from your hand.

lines.zh: 我用角把它挑起，甩上背。
lines.en: I flick it up with my horn and onto my back.
My feet aren't nimble.
It fell back to the ground.
I looked and left.

lines.zh: 我看了看，还是留在地上。
lines.en: I look at it and leave it on the ground.

lines.zh: 枝下的动静，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: I see every movement beneath the branch.

lines.zh: 我这只角的影子，压住你了。
lines.en: My horn's shadow falls over you.
My wings are half open.
I'm coming down from the tree.
The wind favors me; my horn is aimed.
It doesn't run fast — the carapace arrives first.
I land in front of it.
These horns can push a tree aside.
My horn points at it.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开一半，随时能冲。
lines.en: My wings open halfway; I can charge anytime.
My feet have gripped the branch.
It's only a few steps off.

lines.zh: 我跟着它飞，翅膀压低树梢。
lines.en: I follow it, wings pressing the treetops flat.
It ducks into the jungle.
The trees are too dense.
I can't fly fast.
I land and follow on foot.

lines.zh: 它还在往前，我贴着树皮追。
lines.en: It keeps going; I track it along the bark.
I push a vine aside.
It turned its head.
I'm airborne again.
It turns into the tree shadow; I have marked it.
I go around behind it.
I climb down along the bark.
I dive in and ram.
My horn connected.
My horn knocks it back two steps.

lines.zh: 我又扑空，角只擦到树皮。
lines.en: I miss again; my horn only scrapes the bark.
My wings kick up leaves.
It got caught by them.
I rammed a second time.
It dodged most of it.
I land and stop.
By the time I land, it has fled.
I flap my wings.
I shake the dust off my shell.
I come down from the canopy.
My shell shines in the light.
My wings beat loud.
My sound fills the jungle.
I land by a large tree.

lines.zh: 这片林子虫多，我不愁吃。
lines.en: This forest is full of insects; I will not go hungry.
I can stay a long while.
You're standing over there.

lines.zh: 我从树上下来，不认识你。
lines.en: I come down from the tree; I do not know you.

lines.zh: 但这里不是我一个人的。
lines.en: But this place isn't mine alone.
There are other bugs in this tree.
No hurry.
Let me eat first.
The fruit on this tree is ripe too.

lines.zh: 火烧到翅膜，我飞得歪了。
lines.en: Fire caught my wing membrane and my flight went crooked.
My shell hit first and bounced.
My wings are heavy in water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从枝上掀了下去。
lines.en: The blast knocked me off the branch.
An arrow lodged in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我的眼睛花。
lines.en: A flash struck and my eyes blurred.

lines.zh: 丛林里虫子少了，我有点虚。
lines.en: Fewer bugs in the jungle. I'm weakening.
Lightning struck the canopy. I ducked low.
There's no branch to land on here.
